## Description

Used in [Start Damage Modification](/wiki/articles/start+damage+modification). Specifies which of the action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.

## Options
- **None** 
- **Receivers and Damagers** 
- **Receivers Damagers and Damage Percent**
